evidence: inventory p95 latency jumped from ~4.8ms to ~2.42s around 12:17:30Z, causing HighLatency alerts across inventory, orders, and gateway
Per-route latency metrics show inventory routes /products (2.42s) and /reserve (2.42s) driving the slowdown, while orders /orders/{order_id} (9ms) and payments /charge (95ms) remain fast
Traces (e.g. request_id=0231f2872c62) show inventory /reserve took 1240.9ms of the 1329.6ms total duration for orders POST /orders and 1339.4ms for gateway POST /api/checkout
diagnosis.summary: The inventory service is experiencing high latency on its /products and /reserve endpoints (~1.5s - 2.4s), which propagates upstream into orders and gateway, causing slow checkouts and product browsing.
causal_chain: inventory: internal processing latency on /products and /reserve endpoints increases to ~1.5s - 2.4s
orders: calls to inventory /reserve take >1.5s, driving up POST /orders checkout latency to ~2.4s
gateway: calls to orders /orders and inventory /products take ~2.4s, causing customer-facing latency on checkout and product browsing
ruled_out: postgres / db pool: db_pool_connections in_use=0 and waiting=0, order lookups are fast (9ms), ruling out database connection exhaustion or lock contention
payments: payments /charge p95 latency is only 95ms, ruling out card processing delays
orders: orders is fast except when awaiting downstream inventory /reserve
gateway: gateway routes not touching inventory (like GET /api/orders/{order_id} at 24ms) remain fast
